test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 17 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) in the following series to continue the pattern?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ad09dfd9f348867d3951b62ebd18a070b05089c2aa698648681e3ad75e699c0d.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

From figure 1 to 2, and figure 3 to 4:

Top middle symbol is replaced by a new symbol.

Bottom-left and all 3 middle symbols are shifting their position in an anticlockwise direction.

From figure 2 to 3, and figure 4 to 5:

Top-middle and all 3 middle symbols are shifting their position in a clockwise direction.

Bottom-left symbol is replaced by a new symbol.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/196a4f26a5cdb16d5341b7d9b99b1a71e23cc29e810b5a7b6d1ba34004cbaaa3.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
